# 原代码
q_proj = self.paligemma_with_expert.paligemma.language_model.layers[0].self_attn.q_proj
dtype = q_proj.weight.dtype

# 修复：兼容 LoRALinear
q_proj = self.paligemma_with_expert.paligemma.language_model.layers[0].self_attn.q_proj
dtype = q_proj.base_layer.weight.dtype if hasattr(q_proj, 'base_layer') else q_proj.weight.dtype
```
